We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now we're expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Growth Influencer Marketing (m/f/d) Your Role

 * You'll build a UGC content machine at fonio.ai

 * Not influencer marketing in the classic sense.

Instead: systematic, scalable, data-driven creator management.

 * Recruit hundreds of micro- & nano-creators

 * Develop scripts, hooks & frameworks

 * Manage deadlines, quality & output

 * Analyze performance data and iterate constantly

 * Have an eye for what works

 * Organize payouts & operational workflows

 * Build processes & tools for creator tracking

What to expect:

 * Massive scale: We don't think in 10 videos per month. We think in 400+ per week.

 * Full ownership: You'll build this channel from 0 to 1, and then from 1 to 100.

 * Budget & speed: When something works, we scale it immediately.

 * Direct impact on revenue: At fonio.ai, content is a clearly measurable growth channel.

 * Fast-paced environment: No long decision chains. No politics. Just output.

What You Bring

 * Experience in UGC, TikTok, or Reels marketing

 * Strong understanding of viral hooks & storytelling

 * A great feel for creator dynamics

 * Exceptional organizational skills

 * Data-driven thinking (views, retention, hook rate, watch time)

 * High ownership & speed

 * Native-level German

 * Speak English at a business level

Bonus:

 * Experience with creator-scaling models

 * Experience in B2B or SaaS

 * Experience with affiliate/performance structures

What We Offer

 * €60,000-85,000 gross annual salary + equity

 * On-site in Vienna

 * Relocation package

 * An extremely fast learning curve

 * A product that's scaling massively

 * A growth story that's only just beginning

Application Process

 * 15-min intro call

 * 45-min deep dive + short growth case

 * 45-min culture & ownership conversation

How we hire?

We're AI-native, including in hiring. AI helps us to remain efficient, but people make every decision.

fonio is an equal opportunity employer. We hire for talent and ownership, whatever your background is.

Need an adjustment in the process? Just tell us.

Please send your CV in English. Then knock us off our feet ¿
